remarks: Don't miss this incredible opportunity to own a charming and updated 2-family home in Stamford! Featuring two spacious units, each with 2 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom, this property is in move-in condition-ready to rent or owner-occupy. Steeped in 1920s character and detail, the home seamlessly blends historic charm with modern updates, offering timeless appeal. Each unit boasts a formal dining room, perfect for entertaining, while the walk-up attic provides fantastic storage or the potential for additional living space-the possibilities are endless! Outside, enjoy a private backyard for relaxation, along with a carport for off-street parking, adding convenience and value. Located just minutes from downtown Stamford and major transportation, this home offers the perfect balance of city access and suburban charm. A rare find with so much flexibility-schedule your showing today!
